mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_note_collection (user_id, note_id, create_time, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{noteId}, #{createTime}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, note_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, create_time = EXCLUDED.create_time WHERE t_note_collection.status <> EXCLUDED.status

INSERT INTO t_note_collection (user_id, note_id, create_time, status) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.noteId}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.status})
